messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a canary push for feature/ebbflow this Wed 09:30 PT. Who's available to own smoke + rollback? :rocket:
jon: I can own smoke checks and run the quick latency sweep. I'll be oncall that window.
kevin: I'll be on standby for rollback. Can we keep the initial cohort small?
mar ia: oops typo — maria: Initial plan: 1% internal -> 5% beta users -> 20% regional (US-W, EU) -> 50% -> 100%. 15m wait between increments, health gating on error-rate <0.5% and p95 latency delta <50ms.
olivia: Sounds good. For cohort selection, prefer user-cohort tags: internal, beta, geo:us-west, geo:eu-central.
jon: Also will run these checks at each step: `curl -sS https://canary.health/check | jq .` and compare `errors` and `p95_ms`.
kevin: Rollback steps ready: `deploy rollback feature/ebbflow --to last-stable` in the deploy console + purge KV cache for model routing. I tested locally.
s-releases-bot: scheduled deploy window reserved for feature/ebbflow on 2024-11-14T09:30:00-08:00 (PT). Owner: maria. Reminder will post 30m before.
maria: Quick ask — can we add a temporary rate limit of 300rps for the canary cohort to limit blast radius?
jon: Yep we can gate with the rate limiter rule `rl:ebbflow_canary=300`. I'll push it 5m before start.
olivia: Are there any telemetry dashboards we should watch live?
jon: Watch `ebbflow/latency`, `ebbflow/errors`, and `routes/canary-ebbflow/throughput`. I made a dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/ebbflow-canary
kevin: Who will confirm successful smoke before the 5% bump? Maria?
maria: I'll confirm smoke for 1% and 5%. Jon will own 20% and 50% checks. Kevin hits rollback if anything spikes.
deploy-bot: smoke-check: run smoke-suite --suite quick-smoke --target canary || alert #eng-oncall
jon: Minor note — if p95 jumps but errors are fine, we hold and run a prefix-KV cache warmup (30s) then re-evaluate.
olivia: Regarding logs: enable debug for route `canary-ebbflow` for first 10 minutes, then ramp down to info.
kevin: If we need to abort, call the rollback and then mark the canary cohort as disabled in the routing table.
maria: Plan OK for me. I'll post rollout checklist in the runbook and ping 15m prior. :thumbsup:
jon: I'll be on Slack and in deploy console. Set me to do the manual gating at each percentage.
kevin: Same here. Standby on phone if urgent.
s-releases-bot: reminder: 30m until scheduled canary for feature/ebbflow.
maria: Thanks all — going to finalize the canary runbook and add the exact commands. If anyone has objections speak up now.
olivia: All good from security/observability side.
jon: No objections. See you Wed. :eyes:
kevin: Approved.
